title: Top-down map
description: One map for topdown-map-viewer. Plan coordinates: x east, y north, z up, in map units (units_per_meter of them make a metre). Yaw is degrees counter-clockwise from +x, seen from above. Every list is optional, so a map can start as a few polygons and grow.

name.description: Shown in the status line and used as the PNG file name.

units_per_meter.description: 1 for metres, 100 for centimetres (Unreal), 3.28084 for feet.

bounds.description: The playable area. Drawn as ground (unless fill_bounds is false) and used to frame the camera.

frame.description: What the camera frames, when it should differ from bounds.

palette.description: Named styles that elements refer to with "style". A style with a label appears in the legend. Built-in styles: ground, grass, water, road, asphalt, path, sand, dirt, concrete, wood, stone, building, roof, hedge, tree, bush, rock, marker.

legend.description: An explicit legend. When left out, the legend lists the used palette styles that have a label.

layers.description: Layers get a show/hide checkbox. Built-in layers (ground, water, roads, structures, props, markers) need no entry; list one here to rename it or hide it by default. Any other layer id an element uses gets a checkbox too.

areas.description: Flat filled polygons: ground, water, fields, car parks. Later areas draw on top.

frame.description: Include in camera framing when the map has no bounds.

layer.description: Default: water for style water, else ground.

paths.description: Lines with a width: roads, trails, rivers, fences seen from above.

objects.description: Stand-in shapes. box, cylinder, cone and sphere are scaled to size (layer structures). tree, bush and rock have a natural size and are drawn instanced, so thousands are fine (layer props).

anchor.description: Whether pos is the bottom centre or the middle of the shape.

size.description: [width along local x, depth along local y, height], map units. Default: one metre (solid shapes) or the natural size (foliage).

scale.description: Foliage only, when size is not given: multiplies the natural size.

pitch.description: Degrees about local y; applied after roll, before yaw.

roll.description: Degrees about local x; applied first.

markers.description: Points of interest: spawns, pickups, objectives. Glowing, with a hover label.

size.description: box only: [x, y, height] in map units.

meshes.description: glTF files (.gltf or .glb, metres, +y up, north along -z unless north_axis says +z). They keep their own materials unless style or color is given. A glTF node whose extras has "layer" follows that layer's checkbox.

frame.description: Include in camera framing. Default: true on the ground and water layers.

recolor.description: Recolour parts of the mesh by node name: the first rule whose regular expression matches wins. The name is the nearest node with extras.layer, else the mesh node's own. With flag, a rule only applies where the glTF material's extras has that key set (for example materials an exporter could not read).

stats.description: Free-form numbers about the map. A catalog can copy them into its table.

meta.description: Anything else; the viewer ignores it.

xyz.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z]; z defaults to 0

color.description: Any CSS colour three.js understands, such as #2f7fa8 or steelblue.
